goal: A red found once is not found again by re-running: the merger keeps each red round's failing tests on disk and hands their path, files and a re-run line to the next session and the mend.
The same tree is not measured twice: a session's green `mc gate` on a clean tree is reused by the merger when the candidate's tree, selection and gate version match exactly.
A test red on main does not make an unrelated PR red; a declared timing test gets one more run before it does.
`mc gate` answers inside the 600 s tool limit, writes its log as it runs, runs once per worktree, says truthfully what failed, and runs named test files too.

success_criteria.criterion: A red merger round leaves `~/mc/runner/merge-red/<repo>-<pr>.txt`, and the retry preamble and the mend prompt for that PR name its path, its red files and a re-run line.
success_criteria.check: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/repo-gate.test.js tests/mc/mend.test.js tests/mc/run-plan.test.js` passes with the step-4 tests.

success_criteria.criterion: `mc gate` over a command that outlives its budget prints `RUNNING`, exits 3, and `mc gate --wait` later prints the verdict from the same log; a second `mc gate` in the same worktree meanwhile refuses.
success_criteria.check: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/gate-command.test.js tests/mc/gate-local.test.js` passes with the step-1 to step-3 tests.

success_criteria.criterion: A round whose candidate matches a recorded green skips the suite and says so; a red only on files red on main and untouched by the PR goes on; a red only in a `retry_once` file that passes alone goes on.
success_criteria.check: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/repo-gate.test.js tests/mc/merger.test.js` passes with the step-5 to step-8 tests.

steps.title: `mc gate` writes its log as it runs, answers within a budget, and runs once per worktree
steps.done_when: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/gate-command.test.js tests/mc/gate-local.test.js` passes with the new tests (create `tests/mc/gate-command.test.js` if no test file covers `src/mc/commands/gate.js` yet), and `mc gate` is green.
comments: mc gate now runs the repository's gate as a detached child that writes its log as it runs (and its exit code beside it), answers within --budget (default 540 s; the poll never sleeps past the budget), and prints RUNNING with exit 3 when the budget runs out — the gate runs on, and mc gate --wait prints the verdict from the same log. One gate per worktree: a lock at <git-dir>/mc-gate.json holds {pid, log, started, command}; a second mc gate refuses with exit 2 while that pid lives and the gate has not written its exit code; a dead pid or an existing exit file makes the lock stale. The run() tests moved from gate-local.test.js to tests/mc/gate-command.test.js (15 tests, all deps injected); gateCommand, summarizeGate and gateLines are unchanged. Steps 2-7 start from this verb: the log, the exit file and the lock are the things they read.

steps.title: The RED line counts every reporter block and names what failed
steps.done_when: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/gate-local.test.js` passes with the new tests, and `mc gate` is green.
comments: summarizeGate sums every ℹ tests/ℹ fail block (memoro's ci prints one per lane; the last-wins overwrite made 59 of 66 REDs read 'N tests, 0 failed'), names failed command gates (command x: fail) in gates, and keeps a 'ci runner:' refusal with its '- <path>' lines (up to 10) as failures. gateLines puts 'command gate failed: …' on the RED line, and says 'N tests counted — the failure is below' when counts show no failure but one is named. The existing red-line expectation for counts-less output changed to that wording, as the step's clause requires; the files-count form (ci summary) is kept as it was.

steps.title: `mc gate <files…>` runs named test files with the same log and summary
steps.done_when: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/gate-command.test.js tests/mc/gate-local.test.js` passes with the new tests, and `mc gate` is green.
